name: Yoked rings, all six rotations of Experiment 1 (Persinger 2010, 30 min)
origin: Persinger lab, Laurentian University (Persinger, Saroka, Lavallee, Booth, Hunter, Mulligan, Koren, Wu & Gang 2010), yoked circumcerebral rings
summary: Experiment 1 of Persinger et al. 2010 in full: six rotations of the shared field, 5 min each, in the paper's order (200, 100 and 20 ms on the first coil, first lengthening and then shortening from coil to coil). Two people 5 m apart wore identical rings driven together. The paper reports its effect in the other person's right parietal EEG for one of the six: 100 ms lengthening by 10 ms per coil.
notes: Persinger 2010 p.2 [232]: a second, identical array of 8 solenoids on the second person, the chairs 5 m apart, both arrays connected to the same computer; configurations 200-20, 100-10, 20-2, 200+20, 100+10 and 20+2 for 5 min each. In this paper '+' shortens and '-' lengthens the time per solenoid: for 100 +10 the first solenoid (left frontal) was on for 100 ms and the second for 90 ms. An EEG baseline of 20 s was taken at 2 min of a configuration; then one person saw a dim green light of about 10 lux flashing at 8.3 Hz for 40 s. The effect, more 8 to 9 Hz power over the right parietal region of the other person, is reported for 100-10, that is 100, 110, 120 ms and so on to 170 ms. persinger-yoked-2010-microstate plays 100+10, the configuration for which experiments 2 and 3 of the same paper report the effect (p.3 [233]). The paper states neither the waveform nor the field strength. This program plays the 849-point Thomas table of US 6,234,953 at 1-ms points, as persinger-yoked-2010-microstate does: that is an assumption. One helmet delivers half of the protocol. The paper's claim is about two people in the same field, which needs a second ring carrying the same currents and an EEG on each person. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. One lab.
setting: As in the paper: two people in separate rooms, each with a ring, EEG on the person who does not see the light. At 2 min of each 5-min block take 20 s of EEG as the baseline, then show the other person 40 s of flashes at 8.3 Hz and record again.
source: Persinger, Saroka, Lavallee, Booth, Hunter, Mulligan, Koren, Wu & Gang 2010, Neurosci Lett 486:231-234 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20887774/ ; Persinger & Lavallee 2010, Theoretical and experimental evidence of macroscopic entanglement between human brain activity and photon emissions, J Conscious Explor Res 1(7):785-807 (20+2 notation; coil 1 left frontal, coil 8 right prefrontal) https://jcer.com/index.php/jcj/article/view/99 ; Dotta & Persinger 2012, "Doubling" of local photon emissions when two simultaneous, spatially-separated, chemiluminescent reactions share the same magnetic field configurations, J Biophys Chem 3:72-80 (859- and 230-point patterns at 1 ms; primer/effector order) https://file.scirp.org/Html/17181.html ; Lehman 2016, PhD thesis, Laurentian University ("20-2" = 20, 22 ... 34 ms) https://laurentian.scholaris.ca/server/api/core/bitstreams/e7b03302-1b7f-4f4f-acf5-bdf41ee5370f/content ; Thomas, Prato, Kavaliers & Persinger, US 6,234,953 B1, Table 1 (Thomas pulse point values) https://patents.google.com/patent/US6234953B1/en ; Buckner et al. 2015, PLoS ONE 10(4):e0124136 (Thomas file: 849 points at 3 ms) https://europepmc.org/article/MED/25875081 ; Booth, Koren & Persinger 2008, Electromagn Biol Med 27:426-436 (counter-clockwise vs clockwise) https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19037792/ ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1-6 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
